capabilities: Browse and search vault images with sorting, grouping, filtering, and reference analysis
Insert images with position, dark-theme inversion, captions, or a responsive grid callout
Resize embedded images by dragging their lower-right edge in Live Preview
Move, rename, and trash image files, including unreferenced ones in batch
View images in a full-window viewer with zoom and pan
extras: Desktop-only (Windows, macOS, Linux) and requires Obsidian 1.12.1 or later; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Installable via BRAT as a beta plugin. Works fully locally with no network requests. Drag resizing and context-menu actions work only in Live Preview and only for Wiki link embeds, not Markdown image syntax.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to browse image files in bulk, check which notes reference them, apply layouts and captions to embeds, or drag-resize images, so image cleanup and placement are manual.

relations.evidence: The image viewer was inspired by Image Toolkit
drag resizing was inspired by AttachFlow

summary: Image management plugin that browses, inserts, resizes, captions, and batch-trashes vault images with reference analysis and a full-window viewer.
